card.name: Punctuation in academic citations
card.fires_on: Punctuation and digits inside bibliography entries, such as the period after a publisher, a closing parenthesis after a year, or a digit in an ISBN or DOI. Mostly philosophy and statistics reference lists.

modes.label: Citation punctuation
modes.description: Period or parenthesis right after a publisher, journal year or author name in a reference list.

modes.label: Digits in ISBN or DOI
modes.description: A single digit inside an ISBN or DOI string.
